headline: Cage Cashier
workPreference: Manufacturing & Production, Warehouse & Fulfillment, Customer Service & Events, Cleaning & Facilities
summary: Experienced manufacturing and retail professional with hands-on experience in forklift-related duties and a strong background in team leadership, supervision, and daily operations management. Skilled in overseeing store and operational performance, training and certifying staff, and ensuring high-quality customer service. Background includes managing financial transactions, scheduling, payroll, inventory control, and product ordering across retail and food service environments. Brings strong organizational, administrative, and customer service skills along with delivery driving and merchandising experience.
